notes.title: Cards We're Dealt Directors Cut Update
notes.notes: [h1][b]Cards We're Dealt 1.0.4.8  [/b][/h1][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43722029/4b6f77b12f5a7ad9870065e3ad4d08b2846f4643.gif"][/img][/p][p][i]Directors Cut Part IV[/i] is here! This concludes all remaining changes I wanted to make to the game for the time being! The game will launch everywhere next month. [/p][p]Next time you hear from me the game will be out on Playstation.  [/p][p]Back to work on Tiny Planet...  [/p][p]Love you. Appreciate everyone's patience.   [/p][p]Thanks for playing,   [/p][p][/p][p]Cole[/p][p] [/p][p][/p][p][/p][p] [/p]
